Ready for launch

Everything you need to get started.

A short, practical handover gives us what we need to shape, connect and approve your AI call agent.

  1. Your business phone setupThe number or phone system the agent should answer, plus any routing requirements.
  2. Call flow preferencesHow calls should open, which questions matter and when a person should take over.
  3. A calendar to connectThe appointment calendar, working hours, service areas and booking rules we should follow.
  4. Services and approved pricingThe services, FAQs and any prices or ranges you are comfortable having the agent quote.
  5. One approval contactA person who can review the script, test calls and sign off on changes before launch.

Have most of this ready? We can map the rest together in a focused 15-minute conversation.
